reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, dayFromDate and the shared getDateWithWeekendRule for the weekend move, but re-derives the daily-schedule weekend skip itself and imports parseISO separately instead of using monthUtils.parseDate / the existing `d` namespace.

duplication.why: The daily-schedules-skip-weekends rule (frequency === 'daily' && skipWeekend && isWeekend) is restated as a filter, duplicating the decision getNextDate makes inline; the rest is new logic.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts, is registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its neighbours, and leaves the date arithmetic to shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Readable pipeline with a comment on the two-day margin, but the daily-skip rule now lives in two places in different shapes, so changing it needs both edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend adjustment goes through getDateWithWeekendRule; no existing shared helper for the daily skip was bypassed (getNextDate keeps it inline).

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts restates getNextDate's daily weekend-skip loop (shared/schedules.ts) as a `.filter(!(isDaily && config.skipWeekend && d.isWeekend(date)))`, reshaped rather than extracted and shared.
